column1: # dbtable.furniture carries neither a loc column nor an xp column, and the obj and loc
# names use different vocabularies, so none of this can be derived from the cache. It is
# transcribed from an OSRS 184 reference server, whose item ids match this cache's.
# Several locs on a row are the parts of one multi-tile piece; which part goes where is
# decided by name, not by the order here. A blank xp falls back to the material total.
# Rows sharing a model_obj (a few seasonal variants do) keep the first one's xp.
